whyMe.headline: Why me
whyMe.text: I am retraining as a software developer at the Developer Akademie, learning to build modern web apps from frontend to backend. What excites me most is turning an idea into something people actually use. I enjoy solving tricky problems step by step and learning every day.

skills.headline: My Skills
skills.challengeText: I am always happy to learn new technologies. Just tell me what you need.

projects.headline: My Projects
projects.join: Task manager inspired by the Kanban system. Create and organize tasks with drag and drop and assign them to contacts.
projects.elPolloLoco: 2D jump and run game with JavaScript and the Canvas API. Help Pepe collect coins and salsa bottles to defeat the giant hen.
projects.pokedex: Pokédex with data from the PokéAPI. Search for Pokémon, load more and view their info, stats and evolutions.

contact.headline: Contact me
contact.text: Got a question, a project or an open position? Write me a message. I am looking for a job as a fullstack developer.
contact.privacyAfter: and agree to the processing of my data as outlined.
